story.intent: An elderly man returns to his abandoned childhood home and quietly confronts the passage of time.

style.visual_philosophy: The man remains concrete and sharply present while traces of the past appear softer and quieter; nostalgia is restrained rather than sentimentalized.
style.shape_language: simple horizontal calm interrupted by vertical door and wall marks
style.material_language: worn wood, faded plaster, oxidized metal, dusty floor
style.color_strategy: muted warm neutrals with restrained cool daylight
style.contrast_strategy: moderate local contrast around face, hand, and wall marks

character.appearance: Chinese man in his late seventies, lean face, short silver hair
character.costume: plain dark jacket and faded trousers

world.materials: faded plaster, old timber, dusty concrete
world.spatial_rules: doorway on right, old height marks on left interior wall

scene.intent: Show that he has returned physically but is still measuring himself against the child he once was.
scene.decisive_moment: His fingertips touch the faded childhood height marks while his body remains angled toward the open doorway.
scene.visual_state: late afternoon natural light, still air

performance.head: turned toward the wall
performance.hands: right fingertips lightly touching the highest faded mark

evidence.environment: furniture ghost marks, old nail holes, worn door handle

staging.blocking: man in right third, height marks in left-center
staging.orientation: body toward exit, attention toward past
staging.distance: close enough to read hand and wall marks
staging.eyeline: toward wall marks, never toward camera

composition.primary: the man's face and hand touching the wall
composition.negative_space: empty room between man and far wall

camera.depth: enough depth to keep hand and wall evidence readable

light_color.key_direction: soft side daylight from left window
light_color.value_structure: face and hand slightly brighter than room
light_color.palette_state: muted warm gray-brown with cool daylight edge
